answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the jetty check immediately, the prism audit keeps the resolved set and the sable replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 106 aliases thus pays the reading cost 106 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
